role: Emits an A2UI v1.0 runtime catalog and surface payloads; styling delegated to the renderer's registered components
realises: Compiles component contracts into an A2UI v1.0 catalog document (JSON Schema per component) and lowers each composition into a `createSurface` + `updateComponents` message pair. SPIKE STATUS: authored from the a2ui-from-specs spike (DirectedEdges/spectacular#961); rows carry basis: implementation and are unverified beyond the spike's validation harness.
note: This platform transmits the prop and composition surfaces only. No style key is read: an A2UI node carries props, children and data bindings, and all visual styling lives in the renderer's registration of the design system's own components — the same delegation React makes to CSS, made to the host application instead. The one exception is primitive lowering: an un-promoted layer's styles are read through the workspace's `conventions.primitives` promotion table to become a configured component's props, which is a convention-driven read of specific tokens, not a binding of the style surface.

surfaces.note: Catalog generation is per component; surface emission is per composition and per instance example (each ready-made usage becomes its own one-root surface under components/<Name>/examples.json). Constraint lowering (invalidPropCombinations → not/anyOf), state omission (statesToContract) and placeholder lowering ({Placeholder} text → data-model @path bindings) are this platform's own rules, declared in concepts.propRules.

boolean.realises: a JSON Schema property `$ref` to A2UI `DynamicBoolean`, carrying the declared `default`
boolean.notes: DynamicBoolean admits a literal or a data-model binding, so any boolean prop is bindable at runtime without a schema change. A boolean classified as a browser-managed state concept never reaches the catalog.

string.realises: a `$ref` to A2UI `DynamicString`, nullable-widened via `anyOf` with `null`
string.notes: Widened per ADR-065 nullability. `examples` pass through as JSON Schema `examples`, where they guide model generation the way they guide stories elsewhere.

enum.realises: a plain JSON Schema `enum` with the declared `default`; `nullable: true` adds `null` to the value list
enum.notes: Kept literal rather than Dynamic: a closed variant set is a design decision, not a runtime value to bind. An enum whose every state concept is browser-managed (a state prop) never reaches the catalog.

number.realises: a `$ref` to A2UI `DynamicNumber`, with `enum`, `default` and `examples` carried through
number.notes: Surface emission coerces a Figma TEXT-authored string value back to a number where the contract declares the kind, mirroring the inference that minted the prop.

slot.realises: a `$ref` to A2UI `ChildList` under the slot's own prop name; `minChildren`/`maxChildren` become `minItems`/`maxItems`
slot.notes: `anyOf` component constraints are stated in the property description and unioned into the definition's `allowedChildren` when every slot is constrained; `$text`/`$glyph` markers become description guidance, since A2UI children are component references only.

image.realises: a `$ref` to A2UI `DynamicString` carrying the registry reference
image.notes: A2UI has no image registry; the workspace reference is passed as a string the host must resolve to a URL. Lossy until a resolution convention exists.

object.realises: a JSON Schema `object` with one property per member, each mapped by its own scalar kind; `additionalProperties: false`
object.notes: Member names are the library's own, untranslated.

statesToContract.resolution: A prop whose every state concept resolves to omit is removed from the component definition's properties and from every emitted node; a constraint naming it drops with it.
statesToContract.partial: Omission is all-or-nothing per prop: one kept concept on the prop and it transmits whole.
statesToContract.notes: The states fork (`conventions.specs.states`): a prop whose every concept entry resolves to `contract: 'omit'` (via from-specs' `buildOmittedProps`) reaches neither the catalog's component definition nor any surface payload — captured interaction state like `state: Hover` or `focus: true` is the renderer's to own at runtime. A kept concept's prop (`disabled`, `readOnly`, `validation`) transmits normally. An `invalidPropCombinations` entry naming an omitted prop describes states the payload can no longer express, so it is dropped with the prop; combinations over kept props alone survive into the `not` block. Verified both ways: a surviving combination still fails validation, and an omitted prop on a wire node fails the message schema via `unevaluatedProperties`.

constraintLowering.resolution: Each expressible forbidden configuration becomes one anyOf branch under the definition's not, const-pinning exactly the props it names, plus a prose summary in the description.
constraintLowering.partial: A combination naming an omitted prop is dropped as unexpressible; the remainder emit.
constraintLowering.notes: `invalidPropCombinations` compile to a `not`/`anyOf` block on the component definition — one `anyOf` branch per forbidden configuration, each branch requiring and const-pinning exactly the props the combination names — plus a natural-language summary in `description` for model guidance. Verified by the spike's negative test: a node carrying a forbidden combination fails catalog validation.

slotsToChildLists.resolution: Layout children attach under the instanced component's defaultSlot prop name (falling back to children); a $slotContent pointer resolves through the examples document and its fill emits into the same flat component list.
slotsToChildLists.partial: A pointer that resolves to no fill drops the prop with a warning naming it.
slotsToChildLists.notes: A composition element's layout children attach to the instanced component under its `defaultSlot` prop name, falling back to `children`. A `$slotContent` pointer in a prop configuration resolves through the composition's examples document to its fill's own `anatomy + elements + layout` triplet, which is emitted into the same flat component list and referenced by id.

numberCoercion.resolution: A string value configured on a declared number prop parses to a number before emission.
numberCoercion.partial: An unparsable value passes through unchanged and fails validation visibly.
numberCoercion.notes: A string value configured on a declared number prop parses to a number before emission; an unparsable value passes through and fails validation visibly.

placeholderBinding.resolution: A configuration whose whole value is {Label} lowers to a data-model binding at /label, and the dataModel seeds the label text as the sample value.
placeholderBinding.partial: Applies only to whole-value placeholders; mixed literal-and-placeholder text stays a literal.
placeholderBinding.notes: A prop configuration whose whole value is `{Label}` lowers to `{"@path": "/label"}` and seeds the surface's `dataModel` with the label text as the sample value — Spectacular's placeholder convention becoming A2UI's two-way data binding.

container.realises: a configured container primitive component, via the promotion table
container.notes: Only where a promotion rule resolves; a bare fixed-size frame does not lower.

text.realises: a configured text primitive component, via the promotion table

glyph.realises: a configured glyph primitive component, via the promotion table

instance.realises: a surface node whose `component` is the instanced catalog symbol
instance.notes: An instance of a component the catalog does not define is dropped with a warning naming it.

vector.notes: No catalog symbol; dropped with a warning.

roles.$comment: SPIKE: roles inform, they do not emit markup here. Activation obligations drive the node's `action.event`; state obligations resolve context bindings; `alert`/`status` imply `@accessibility.live`; `decoration` implies `hidden`; semantics are the renderer registration's job.

literal.realises: the node's prop value; a whole-value `{Placeholder}` lowers to a data-model binding (placeholderBinding)

mixed.notes: The mixed sentinel states variance, not a value; nothing is emitted for it.

token.notes: Tokens resolve inside the registered components; a payload never carries one.

theme.notes: Theme selection is the host application's; the payload carries none.

binding.notes: A `$binding` names a prop relation inside one component, which the renderer's implementation already realises.

conditional.notes: Conditional styling is the registered implementation's.

slotContent.realises: the fill's triplet, emitted into the flat component list and referenced by id (slotsToChildLists)

subcomponent.notes: A SubcomponentRef `instanceOf` is not a string symbol; the element drops with a warning. Flattened subcomponent names resolve normally.

elementType.notes: External element-type definitions do not transmit.

image.realises: the registry reference as a string the host resolves
image.notes: Same loss the image prop kind declares.
